In his youth, this mighty lord once stood fast against an army from hell and single-handedly defeated them by sealing the gateway that spew them. He then became sovereign of his realm.

Every child trembles at the hearing of this most infamous name. This lord of hell is known for his blood thirsts. It is said that he once ate 1000 slaves at a banquet given by Bethrezen for a victory against the kingdom of light.

Known in her times as the mightiest of all adepts of the black art, this lord was slain by the inquisitor Vorgel who ended her reign of terror. She is now resurrected as an undead with the intention to subjugate every mortal to her will.
A veteran in the struggle to reclaim Elven glory, nobody enters the forest without his knowledge.

Air Elemental 
"Halt! Within that tower resides a red dragon. The fiery beast is not to be bothered! If you should defeat the beast you will receive 2 000 gold and a Banner of War for your rewards."

Air Elemental 
"Foul creature I shall give you fair warning. Within that tower is the fiery red dragon. If you defeat this beast you will be rewarded with 2 000 gold and a Banner of War. The choice is yours you have been warned."

Air Elemental 
"Halt! I appear to warn you and offer you a choice. Within that tower is the red dragon a fiery beast of mass destruction. Should you defeat this beast you will be rewarded 2 000 gold and a Banner of War! The choice is yours!"

Air Elemental 
"Foul creatures of the Undead Hordes! I appear to offer you a choice. The tower is home to a red dragon! This fiery beast is fierce! Should you defeat this creature you shall be rewarded with 2 000 gold and a banner of war! Farewell!"

Air Elemental 
"The mighty beast has fallen by your hand. You shall be rewarded as promised. Use your wealth wisely. With this gold comes a curse! When a dragon dies many will follow to avenge its loss! You have been warned!"

Dwarf King 
"Fools! Some one has spilled the blood of a dragon. More shall come to take its place! Begone before you become dragon prey!"

Dwarf King 
"Hear my words foul one! Leave this territory at once. Your presence will not be tolerated we will keep our city and our land. Conquer Rock City and you will never know a day's peace! Turn around before the Mountain Clans attack!"

Rock Giant 
"Leave this place at once. The water has claimed many of our lands. We will fight all those who do not belong here. You have been warned leave and never return. Eromonts Citadel will not fall. You have been warned now leave at once!"

Eromont Giant 
"The Mountain Clans have given you fair warning. Like the tide, we will rise take back our home! Prepare for battle!"

Fornstorm Protector 
"Leave now! This city will not fall! To our last breathe we will fight! Leave now or face the wrath of our might! This spell is just a small sample of our might!"

Rock Giant 
"This city belongs solely to the Mountain Clans all intruders shall perish!"

Medusa 
"Stay a little longer and you shall become one with the rocks. Our city has numerous decorations of petrified travellers. This city is ours we have the Mountain Clans statues to prove it! They were mighty now they are decoration as you will be!

Eraric  
"This land can know longer be shared. The water's have made peaceful existance impossible. Leave now or you shall know the fury of my might. By the slight chance that I am defeated many more will come to avenge me! Take your leave now!"

Elder One 
"The invaders have cost great grief. Our fallen shall be avenged!

Elder One 
"With our brother's defeat we will arrive in time to avenge him. None shall ever know peace again!"

Spirit of Fenrir  
"Foul creature! The Elder Ones are mighty and many are on their way. Defeat me in combat and you have the word of the Mountain Clans that the Elder Ones will not appear. Refuse and they shall arrive! The choice is yours!"

Spirit of Fenrir 
"I have been defeated. The Elder One will not arrive. Bewarned that this land is hostile. Proceed with caution!"

Skeleton Warrior 
"Death watches you! Fight me and win and you will be rewarded!

Grovemaiden 
"Please I ask you kindly to leave. We wish to remain out of your conflict. We have built a small home for those who seek to avoid this conflict. With each passing day I see see darkness surrounding your soul!"

Spirit of Fenrir  
"Bewarned that the wolf's den is a place not to be found in. The spirit wolves are vicious and numerous. This wolfpack of the other realm will defeat you easily. I advise you to leave! Now!"

Arch-Devil 
"With great effort we have managed to break the will of these Sea Serpents. We will use them to travel through the dangerous waters. Some parts of the water contain magical healing spells that we can use to help our Sea Serpents!

Apprentice 
"The Empire shall claim these lands. To do so we have trained some Sea Serpents to help us navigate these troublesome waters. The waters are not safe! There are special locations where the waters have absorbed magic. The magic will heal us!

Ashgan  
"Behold the fleet of Sea Creatures. With these creatures we will conquer both land and sea. The waters are dangerous and giving. There is magic in the waters and from time to time we will be healed by these terrifying waters."

Ranger 
"Magic can be found in the water. Some locations will heal our Sea Creatures. Use them wisely for without our Sea Creatures our Quest will prove to be most difficult. The waters are a ferocious place to be! Go now and be careful and good luck!"

Mermaid 
"Silly traveller! These waters are under the reign of the Merfolk! You presence here will be your demise. The treasures that these waters hold are not for you. Begone before I send you to a watery resting place."

Merman 
"You fool! By defeating the Mermaid you have cursed these waters. Sea Creature upon creature will come to avenge her defeat! Stay to the shores from now on the waters are not safe!"
"Master, we have heard that some people have spotted a Green Dragon in the area. Proceed with caution. Be sure to use the fire wards to protect you from the beast's flame!"

Dark Elf Gast 
"Soon the time will be at hand when the Elven Alliance will crumble and be reborn in my image!"

Dwarf 
"Please spare my brothers from your wrath! We have suffered much already!"

Angel 
"Behold! Rock Castle is one of the cities that we must capture and maintain. We cannot let this city fall to our enemies! Onward there is much to do!"

Demon 
"This city falls to our might! We cannot lose Rock Castle. This city and four others are the key to our victory! Guard this city and destory those who would oppose us!"

Death Knight 
"We have worked long to capture this city. We cannot let Rock Castle fall to our enemies. Defend this city and capture the remaining four city's. Victory will be ours!"

Forest Leige 
"The Alliance lives on! Capturing this city brings us closer to total control of the region. We must be sure not to let Rock Castle fall! We must capture the five cities!"

Angel 
"This victory at Eromonts Citadel will be remembered as one of the Empire's greatest triumphs! This Citadel must not fall to our foes! Defend the Citadel as we march closer to victory!"

Death Knight 
"Our enemies fall to us! Victory will be ours! Eromonts Citadel must not fall to our enemies. We will defend this Citadel as we conquer new cities. This city must never fall! Never!"

Arch-Angel 
"The mighty have fallen and this city is now ours! Eromonts Citadel must not fall to our enemies. Defend this Citadel!"

Oracle Elf 
"The Elven Alliance is once again victorious! With this great victory we must ensure that Eromonts Citadel thrives. We cannot let this city fall to our foes!"

Angel 
"Victory to the Empire! For the glory of the Empire we must keep Fornstorm under our control!"

Death Knight 
"Once again the Undead Hordes have destroyed our enemies! Fornstorm must not fall! Defend this city at all costs!"

Arch-Devil 
"Legions Of The Damned hear my voice! This victory is one of many still to come! Defend Fornstorm city from our nemesis!"

Forest Elf 
"We must keep this city from falling to our enemies. We march closer to our total victory!"

Angel  
"Raven Fort falls to the Empire. In its ashes Raven Fort will be rebuilt in the image of the Empire. We must not let our enemies interfere!"

Death Knight 
"The Legions Of the Damned have sworn to take Raven Fort from us! we have captured Raven Fort and the Legions Of The Damned will suffer the same fate as everyone else! Death! Victory is nearly ours, defend Raven Fort from our enemies!"

Arch-Devil 
"The Empire, The Undead Hordes and the Elven Alliance will try to conquer Raven Fort. They shall fail, and fall to our might! Raven Fort will always remain under our control!"

Forest Liege 
"Our enemies surround us! We are strong and Raven Fort will not fall! This city is a piece of our overall victory!"

Angel 
"Hold onto this city at all costs! We need this city to cement our victory!"

Archlich 
"Death shall follow us! Our enemies conspire against us! They want our city they cannot take our castle!"

Arch-Devil 
"Our enemies shall fall to our might! Vysha Castle must not fall to our enemies. We need this city!"

Forest Elf 
"A hard fought victory! We have been well rewarded. This city will be useful and we must not let it fall to outsiders!"

Hill Giant  
"We have lost this round! Bewarned we are many! As I speak the Mountain Clans are sailing the waters in search of our enemies."

Hill Giant 
"The rising waters have destroyed many of our homes. Our possessions float out in the waters out of our reach!"
"These Lizard Men are tough! I am certain that we will come across more of them!"

Orc 
"Dragons! Dragons will come and destroy all!"

Hill Giant 
"The Mountain Clan city Taura is now yours! I warn you now! Be prepared, each year Dragons fly through here and this year will not be different!"

Loremaster 
"We have lost this battle! This war is not over yet!"

Shamaness 
"The land sinks into the sea! Soon it will not matter who lives here!"

Dark Elf Gast 
"Deny your inner drive for as long as you wish! Soon it will not matter the Elven Alliance will crumble and rebuild in our image!"

Dark Elf Gast 
"Victory has escaped us this time!"

Warden 
"We tried to build a peaceful life here away from war. Instead we are defeated by our own! There is a growing shadow that threatens to consume the Elven Alliance!"

Warden 
"The Elven Alliance shall avenge us!"

Oracle Elf 
"The Royal City and its people have been butchered! Look at the misery that you have helped spread. The Elven Alliance is that I have fought for would never do anything like this!"

Oracle Elf 
"We will be avenged by the Elven Alliance! This horrific act will not go unpunished!"
